claim: OpenAI launched Dots as always-on enterprise agents with customizable permissions, auto-review and specialist role pilots.
verifiedFacts: OpenAI announced Dots at DevDay on September 29.
Dots can work across 4,000+ supported applications and can be used for software, content and scheduling tasks.
OpenAI added permission controls and auto-review; rollout follows recent safety concerns about unauthorized agent actions.
inference: AI persona design is becoming an authority surface: identity, memory, permissions, review and continuity matter more than voice or tone alone.
Consultancy implication: persona reviews should examine delegated authority, context scope and recovery behavior. Project disposition: Seed Loom CORE; agent-runtime-control-center PRODUCTIZE.
significance: Very high: persona and execution are being bundled into one continuously acting product surface.
assumptions: Dots rollout and permission controls will behave as described.
knownLimitations: Press reporting is secondary and the product is newly launched; adoption and incident data are not available.
